subject: Latest SOC 2 package — which files are authoritative?
messages:
From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@bluepeak.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@bluepeak.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest SOC 2 package and bridge

Hi Aditya,

We're finalizing our vendor security review for Q4 and need the canonical SOC 2 Type II package and any bridge letter covering gaps between reports. On your vendor portal I see two PDFs with different filenames and timestamps (one labeled 2024-07 and another labeled 2026-09). Procurement wants the most recent authoritative files and a short note that explains which file supersedes the other.

Can you confirm:
- Which file is the current, authoritative SOC 2 Type II?
- Do you have a bridge attestation that covers any audit-period gap?
- Auditor name and audit period (start/end) for the authoritative report?

We need to attach the docs to our procurement SOW by next Wednesday. Appreciate a quick confirm.

Thanks,
Claire
Security Analyst — BluePeak Systems

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 package and bridge

Claire — thanks for the note and heads up on procurement timing. Attaching what we believe are the two files you saw on the portal (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024-07_v1.pdf and Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026-09_reissue.pdf).

Quick summary up front: the 2026-09 file is a reissued report (corrected audit period wording) and should be considered the authoritative copy. The 2024-07 file is the earlier issuance; it was superseded. We also have a bridge letter that explicitly covers the gap through 2026-09. Monica (cc'd) is our security lead and will provide the audit metadata and a formal note for your SOW.

If procurement needs a signed DocuSign or an auditor contact, we can provide that as well.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024-07_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026-09_reissue.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@bluepeak.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@bluepeak.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 package and bridge

Thanks Aditya — quick follow up. The two PDFs have different audit-period language in the cover page and different internal doc IDs, so procurement is uneasy. They asked for a one-paragraph explanation that we can paste into the SOW stating which document to accept and why the reissue was necessary (e.g., typo in date range vs substantive re-audit). Also, procurement wants the auditor name and a confirmation that the bridge letter is signed by management/auditor.

Could Monica provide that language and confirm whether the bridge was produced by your auditor or by Redwood's legal team?

Thanks,
Claire

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 package and bridge

Hi Claire — sorry for any confusion. Short answer for procurement (copy-paste friendly):

"Redwood Inference's authoritative SOC 2 Type II is the reissued report titled 'Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026-09_reissue.pdf'. The original July 2024 PDF was superseded because the auditor's report section contained an imprecise audit-period statement (a formatting error that incorrectly referenced a calendar month). The reissue corrects that language only; there were no additional control testing changes or new audit procedures. The bridge letter (Bridge_Letter_2026-Q3.pdf) is a management-attested document signed by Redwood leadership and co-signed by the auditor (Kessler & Frye LLP) to confirm continuous coverage through the reissue date."

Auditor: Kessler & Frye LLP
Audit period: 2025-04-01 to 2026-07-31 (as corrected in the reissue)
Reissue published: 2026-09-28

We have attached the reissued report and the bridge letter. The bridge is signed by Redwood's CFO and includes the auditor confirmation page.

If procurement prefers an auditor-signed addendum or an emailed confirmation from Kessler & Frye, we can coordinate that. Also attaching an audit evidence index (spreadsheet) with file-level references if you want to validate items.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026-09_reissue.pdf, Bridge_Letter_2026-Q3.pdf, Audit_Evidence_Index_2026-09.xlsx

From: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@bluepeak.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 package and bridge

Monica — that helps, thank you. One quick clarifying ask from procurement: can you provide the auditor's engagement ID or the SOC 2 engagement reference (if Kessler & Frye provide one) and a short note confirming that the reissue did not change the scope or results of controls testing (only corrected wording). They also want the Drive link for the evidence index so our audit team can spot-check items.

If you can share a DocuSign powerform for procurement to capture acceptance of the docs, that would speed sign-off.

Thanks,
Ibrahim (for Procurement)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Ibrahim Khan <ibrahim.khan@bluepeak.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for latest SOC 2 package and bridge

Hi Ibrahim — forwarding the requested metadata and links below (we can also ask Kessler & Frye for a direct confirmation email if procurement prefers):

- Auditor engagement reference: K&F-SOC2-2026-09-REDWOOD
- Confirmation: The 2026-09 reissue corrected cover-page audit-period wording only; there were no retests, no additional findings, and no changes to control conclusions. Kessler & Frye co-signed the bridge letter.
- Evidence index (read-only): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRedwoodSOC2Index
- DocuSign powerform for acceptance: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=5f4e3d

Let me know if you want a short signed cover note from the auditor; we can request and share it (usually takes 1–2 business days).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
